scope: Individual review of A4 and common architecture README against D7, K6 and D3. Contract completeness and conditional proof only; no runtime, physical, target-resource or whole-interface composition acceptance.
assumptions: Initially the semantic-identity-bound object is validated or quarantined.
All admitted operation and fault paths satisfy exactly one specified terminal outcome, with complete validated successor or unchanged prior object or disabled affected authority.
Commit, publication and revocation synchronize with all readers; a valid endpoint alone is insufficient.
Ownership and physical transitions preserve actual source, reset epoch, nonce order and duration; qualified uncertainty is required when input or elapsed time is missing.
Any authorization separately satisfies A5 at its named prefix, horizon and guarantee class.
Exact grouping fixes the row generator, feature semantics and initial state and uses real-arithmetic finite-sum identity.
Useful recovery is conditional on a prospectively qualified scenario class and actual restoration/authorization bounds; permanent faults need a separate qualified fallback.
Lifetime risk survives reset through a valid D3-type or other whole-life construction.

findings.reason: The common contract binds semantic model/calibration/noise/support/coordinate/source/epoch/prefix identities. A4 additionally binds the original prior, chronological state/reach relation and approximation ledger. Consumed and published prefixes remain distinct; an old publication is not silently current.

The three cases preserve the authorization invariant by induction. Complete commit can consume evidence without producing authority; unchanged rollback preserves an existing quarantine; partial/unknown state requires synchronized revocation before readers can rely on it. Valid complete initialization or successor validation is required for meaningful recovery.

Ordered physical transitions and once-only likelihood contributions prevent duplicate posterior/prefix evidence. Detector-window overlap gives no ownership duplication. A failed readout after successful consumption does not reopen that input for ingestion; replay requires established actual ownership.

For fixed row generation and feature semantics the disjoint finite-sum partition preserves mathematical likelihood. A4 explicitly excludes bitwise QR equality, changing-anchor equivalence and dropping apparently uninteresting samples. K6 closed-loop equivalence is not claimed by this ownership argument.

R+T follows only from the two stated compatible bounds. Maximum attempts, scenario class, service budget and post-recovery informative power/use assumptions are specification obligations. Prospective scenario qualification and permanent-fault controls prevent treating every failed run as excluded after the fact. The 82-round diagnostic witness supplies no universal cap.

Older checkpoints remain historical until known gaps are replayed once or qualified uncertainty is propagated. Lost history requires aged-cell-valid public support, not a new-cell assumption. Risk continuity is required and a checksum alone does not supply physical currentness or universal corruption detection.

Acceptance obligations cover admission/update/validation/commit/query/publication faults, source/nonces, duration/rate changes, reset at consumption boundaries, stale handles, restore identity, useful recovery and permanent faults. These are future implementation witnesses; no claim that they have run or exhaust an unspecified fault model is made.

counterexample_search: An invalid quarantined object preserved unchanged stays quarantined and cannot regain authority through rollback.
A query failure after consumption cannot be represented as fresh unconsumed evidence; it remains consumed with unresolved or quarantined authority.
A reader racing partial state violates the explicit synchronization premise, so endpoint induction alone is not being accepted.
A stale publication after reset or an unobserved physical interval cannot be treated as current without replay/qualified propagation and matching authorization.
A boundary-dependent anchor or changed generator violates the grouping premises and needs a separate A6 argument.
Unknown consumption after interruption cannot be repaired by blind retry; actual ownership must be established first.
A permanent sensor/power fault does not satisfy the conditional useful-recovery claim and cannot be hidden by post-hoc scenario redefinition.
Restarting per-boot risk at zero violates the stated lifetime-accounting obligation.

validation.method: Direct premise-by-premise proof and contract audit with adversarial transition traces; comparison to accepted D7/K6/D3 proofs and linked current containment/recovery scope. No empirical run establishes these universal premises.
validation.artifact_policy: Receipt created exclusively; no existing proof, result, review or implementation edited.

remaining_application_obligations: Define the actual transition system and fault, interrupt, power-loss, storage, integrity and consumer models; establish complete commit/rollback/quarantine on every admitted path.
Implement and verify source-bound ownership, actual-duration chronology, immutable publication identity, expiry/revocation and synchronized readers.

Bind recoverable scenarios, attempt limits and service budgets prospectively and prove both restoration R and useful query T under compatible continuing conditions, including fault/sensor/power assumptions.
Qualify gap propagation, aged-cell initialization, checkpoint restoration and lifetime-risk persistence or an alternative valid whole-life construction.
Complete A5/A6/A8 premises before claiming authorized useful runtime operation; broader-support recovery or basis migration needs its own validity and cost proof.
Systemwide composition and the separately arriving interfaces.json/requirements.json are outside this individual review. Their final bindings and consistency need the later composition review.
remaining_limits: Acceptance is bound to exact A4/common README content hashes; substantive changes require independent re-review.
Handwritten conditional argument, not a machine-checked full-program proof.
No concrete recovery controller, deadline, implementation fault completeness, physical coverage, lifetime availability, complete M23 SRAM or target timing established.
Existing desktop containment and an 82-round diagnostic recovery are limited evidence, not fulfillment of this contract.
